summary: Swvl Holdings Corp filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, announcing a $13 million private placement (PIPE) priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules. Coefficient LP, backed by the Sawiris family, will invest $10 million, with an existing shareholder adding $3 million. Swvl will issue 8,990,317 Class A shares at $1.446 per share, implying a total of roughly $13 million. Coefficients Abdalla Ali will join the board. The transaction is expected to close August 27, 2026. Proceeds will fund U.S. expansion and a lending offering. Watch for closing and use of proceeds.
